title: Polynomial-time computation of a paired suffix slice
statement: For every $a,k\in\mathbb{N}$, define a function on bit strings $z$ as follows: parse the total first and second projections of $z$, using the empty word for either projection when parsing fails; drop the first $a(|x|+1)^k$ bits of the second projection, where $x$ is the first projection; then encode the pair consisting of $x$ and the remaining suffix. This function is polynomial-time computable.
